# netcup_scp_rdns (Resource)

Manages reverse DNS entries for an IPv4 or IPv6 address.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "netcup_scp_rdns" "example" {
  ip_version = "ipv4"
  ip         = "192.0.2.10"
  rdns       = "host.example.com"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `ip` (String) The IPv4 or IPv6 address whose rDNS entry is managed.
- `ip_version` (String) IP version. Must be ipv4 or ipv6.
- `rdns` (String) Reverse DNS hostname.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Terraform identifier, set to the IP address.
